description: Shop-floor geometry helper for ENCY. Opens from the utilities menu in an ENCY-styled, non-modal window and solves the everyday machinist geometry: tapers/cones (any three of big/small diameter, length, half angle), right triangles (for chamfers and slopes) and ISO metric threads (pitch, pitch/minor diameter, thread depth, tap-drill size).
author: ishamsiev
tags: Utility, Geometry, Machinist, Taper, Thread, ency-extension
